data: What is the approximate value of the black line at the 10th epoch of the bottom graph?

The bottom graph shows the WER (Word Error Rate) with MPE LM on dev.sub as training proceeds for 200 hours. The black line represents the performance of one of the models during this process. To find the approximate value of the black line at the 10th epoch, we need to look at the y-axis values corresponding to the black line at the 10th mark on the x-axis.

From the figure, the black line appears to be around 38.5 on the y-axis at the 10th epoch. Therefore, the approximate value of the black line at the 10th epoch is **38.5**.
